summary: Perth/Scone Airport is a small general aviation airfield located near Scone in Perth and Kinross, Scotland. It primarily serves private aircraft, flight training, and recreational flying rather than commercial scheduled services. The airport sits in a scenic area close to the historic Scone Palace, the ancient crowning place of Scottish kings.
faqs:
Q: Does Perth/Scone Airport handle commercial flights?
A: No, it is a small general aviation airport with no scheduled commercial services.

Q: What is the airport mainly used for?
A: It supports private flying, flight training, air charter, and recreational aviation activities.

Q: How far is the airport from Perth city centre?
A: It is located approximately 3 miles (5 km) northeast of Perth, near the village of Scone.

Q: Are there any notable landmarks near the airport?
A: Yes, Scone Palace, the historic crowning site of Scottish monarchs, is located close to the airfield.
transport_tips: Reaching Perth/Scone Airport by car is straightforward via the A94 from Perth, with ample parking available on site. Taxi services from Perth city centre typically take around 10 minutes. There is no dedicated public bus service to the airfield, so arranging private transport in advance is recommended.
local_tip: If visiting the area, combine your trip with a stop at Scone Palace just minutes away — its grounds and gardens are among the finest in Scotland and well worth exploring.
